audits.mathematicalReason: Each inner sector has area 3π and therefore probability 1/12; each annular sector has area 9π and probability 1/4. There is one odd-valued inner sector and two odd-valued annular sectors, giving P(odd)=1/12+2(1/4)=7/12 and P(even)=5/12. For independent throws, an odd total arises from the disjoint odd-even and even-odd cases, so its probability is 2(7/12)(5/12)=35/72. This directly supports the proposed probability scopes and the sector-area and parity support scopes.
limitations: The calculation uses the standard interpretation that the two dart throws are independent; the individual area-proportional probabilities alone do not specify their joint distribution.

audits.mathematicalReason: Let the rectangle sides be L>W>0. The arrangement gives outer and inner square sides L+W and L−W, respectively. Hence (L+W)²=4(L−W)². Both proposed routes are valid alternatives, and the area, segment, rectangle, and proportion scopes support these calculations.
